description: This file declares the dmProviderDatabase class, which provides methods to access and manage provider information based on various identifiers such as provider name, model name, property name, and object name. It also includes functions to create query objects and load provider data from a directory.

classes.name: dmProviderDatabase
classes.description: A class that manages provider information, allowing creation of queries and retrieval of provider info by various identifiers.
